tieu_de: Preface
tom_tat: Preface Amitābha Buddha! Hi everybody! Thank Buddha for giving me the precious opportunity to write the book "The Law of Sound without Emotion". A Ngoc, a graduate student, is very embarrassed because of his own karma
noi_dung:
Preface

Amitābha Buddha! Hello everyone!

Thank Buddha for giving me the precious opportunity to write the book "The Law of Sound Without Emotion". The latter, A Ngoc, was very embarrassed, because his own karma was full of obstacles, he could not quickly complete this book according to Buddha's will, and would like to turn to the masses to sincerely repent. A Ngoc will study in the spirit of Mahayana Bodhisattva's great kindness and great compassion for ungodly sentient beings, to continue to complete the work of writing the rest of the "Soundless Law".

Since writing the book "The Law of Emotion" until now, in addition to growing her literary knowledge, A Ngoc has also encountered many things that have never happened before, which are truly extraordinary challenges to her mind and spirit, seriously draining her spirit and energy. When the spirit and energy decline, it is impossible to visit hell, causing the time to write the book to be prolonged, directly leading to the book "The Unconscious Law" being stagnant and unable to be completed.

Composing and writing "The Law of the Law without Mind" makes post-study have great emotions, helping you to deeply grasp the importance of keeping the precepts. There are many people who feel that keeping the precepts is too unrealistic, it is the job of monastics and practitioners, and has absolutely nothing to do with us ordinary people. This way of thinking is not consistent with cause and effect, nor is it consistent with the laws of sound. In fact, the majority of people who have great achievements while still in the human world are as rational as dharma and carefully keep all kinds of precepts.

Maintaining the precepts is the basis of being a human being. Anyone who only needs to keep all five precepts will have all kinds of merit, and anyone who breaks the precepts cannot escape the involuntary reduction of blessings and shortened life span of the negative law. If there is a Buddhist disciple who keeps the precepts, there will be an additional precept, because all future sufferings will have to be borne by oneself.

Post-study can still deeply understand one thing, which is the great compassion of Buddha. This supreme power of great compassion can lead suffering sentient beings like us to escape suffering and be happy. We just need to embrace gratitude and sincerely recite Buddha's name and repent, then we can destroy the karma and suffering of the dark hell.

All of us are ordinary people. As ordinary people, we naturally have all kinds of wrong thoughts and behaviors. When you discover that you have committed a mistake, you should immediately correct it. From now on, do not commit a violation. Take advantage of the years you are still alive to try to keep the precepts, practice good deeds, and recite the Buddha's name to release living beings until the end of your life. Even if you cannot be reborn in the Pure Land, the King of Hell will still treat you lightly and forgive your sins.

Here, I sincerely wish that all of us sentient beings in Nam Thiem Bo Chau can live a pure life, not commit adultery all our lives, have a pure husband and wife practice together, and have good relationships!

After studying shame, Shangguan Ngoc Hoa respectfully pens.

tieu_de: 1. BIRTH AND DEATH BOOK
tom_tat: 1. BOOK OF BIRTH AND DEATH According to what A Ngoc saw, the Book of Life and Death is light yellow in color, has a few patterned lines on the outside, and on the surface are written 3 words "Book of Life and Death", the packaging is according to the church document.
noi_dung:
1. BIRTH AND DEATH BOOK

A pale yellow notebook records all the Good Luck and Happiness of the soul while alive. In the hand of the Judge, there is also a light red book of life and death, recording detailed records of souls in the underworld. The packaging is the same as the light yellow book, only the color is different.

It turns out everything was written early! The code of humanity's destiny and the increase or decrease in longevity, reading the book of life and death and seeing through heaven's plans!

Thank you for your blessings from Buddha! Ride a white lotus!

Amitābha Buddha! A Ngoc bowed his palm to the judge!

“Phan Quan! Today I want to ask a few questions: Is the legend that a positive person can read the book of life and death in the underworld, is it true? Does the book of life and death really exist, what kind of book is it? I heard that positive people who tell fortunes can see the things written in the book of life and death? How much to eat, how much to wear, is it all predetermined before birth? If the lifespan is predetermined, then things like you physical health, normal living, moderate diet, etc. Do these factors increase the predetermined lifespan? Or is it possible to change destiny? Is there a limit to the increase in lifespan?

The judge replied: "In the earth world, there are indeed people who can go to the underworld to read the book of life and death. People who can go to the underworld to read the book of life and death absolutely cannot be ordinary people. They must have a special predestined relationship. Yang people who have not yet reached the end of their lifespan cannot go to the underworld. There are mainly two types of people who come to the underworld: one type comes according to karma, the type who commits all kinds of evil karma while alive, depending on the karma of their life. If you cannot control yourself, in general you commit 3 types of karma: body karma, verbal karma, and mental karma. Body karma includes 3 major types of killing, stealing, and adultery; verbal karma includes 4 types of false speech, evil speech, and mental karma including greed, anger, and ignorance.

As above, it is the karma that living beings often commit. The body has 3 karmas, the mouth has 4 karmas and the mind has 3 karmas. After the soul returns to the earthly realm, here we simply outline it clearly. If we talk about it in detail, there are many types, we cannot say it all here. There is also a type of living beings whose actions are neither good nor evil, good and bad are equal, and when they are born together, they are immediately reborn in the common area of the devil path. That is the first type.

The second type comes from the power of Buddha, the power of vows, the power of blessings and virtue. This type of positive person is definitely a person who cultivates his body with a special mission in the human world. This type of practitioner strictly maintains pure precepts, depending on the situation, they go everywhere to save suffering, to make sentient beings escape suffering and be happy. In order to save sentient beings, they go everywhere to spread the Dharma. If this type of person practices to save sentient beings, he can go to the underworld to read the book of life and death, but such a thing is very rare.

The book of life and death in the underworld is managed by a judge. Normally, it is kept by a judge. The book of birth and death records each person's blessings, whether big or small, how much they eat, how much they wear, their land, property, parents, siblings, illnesses, accidents, and how many lives they have, all clearly recorded.

For example, which person, which year, which month, which day, which hour, which minute, will die, these things are recorded in the book of life and death before being reincarnated in the human world, and cannot be arbitrarily changed. If you want to change, you need to look at the data provided by the birth god next to each living being, and only then can it be changed with the approval of the Supreme King of Hell.

A positive person who uses fortune-telling can see what is written in the book of life and death. As long as a fortune teller has the exact date of birth, he can predict good luck, bad luck, and happiness for a person's entire life, but he can only predict it and cannot change it. Everywhere in the world, there are people who claim to be able to change destiny, fortune, marriage, career, etc. . . , most of them are money-swindling tricks. There are many people who have been told by fortune tellers about their exact past or family statistics, etc. . . , my mind was shaken, thinking that I had encountered a noble person. In addition to a few fortune tellers who are skilled in digital art and can predict accurately, there are many other situations where the fortune teller has a spiritual body.

The spirit has the same divine power as other minds, can know the thoughts of the fortune teller and some things in the past, that positive people cannot distinguish, they think they are lucky to meet a noble person, so they risk their lives to follow the fortune teller's words. After that, there are a series of actions to improve fortunes, improve human relations, improve career fortunes, karma fortunes, health fortunes, feng shui arrangements, etc. . . Dozens of projects change your destiny, but don't know that it will cost a lot of money, a lot

If you want to change your destiny, you don't have to look for a fortune teller to help you change, but you have to rely on your own strength to do it. If you create a lot of good deeds and pray for a lot of blessings, you won't have to look for a fortune teller. If you are blessed, you will have noble people to help you, you will have your own health, family, career, marriage, etc. . . If you want, others can only stand next to you and remind you. Good deeds must be done by oneself, always remembered, morning and night without interruption, then the predetermined destiny can be changed, the individual's book of life and death can be rewritten from the beginning!

A Ngoc, you should know that there are some people who spend their whole lives paying attention to taking care of their physical health, living a reasonable lifestyle, eating moderately, getting enough sleep, exercising a lot, etc. . . These factors cannot increase longevity, they are fundamental and cannot be changed. However, in normal times, if you take good care of yourself, you will naturally not have to suffer from physical diseases.

Actually, the vast majority of sentient beings have no way to greatly change their destiny. They just quietly move towards death, depending on the karma that continues to flow to the corresponding path. Of course, any living being who does good deeds, even if it is a small, insignificant deed, as long as they truly have the intention of benefiting others, will likely receive great good rewards in the future, thereby changing their destiny. There are two types of people who can influence the trajectory of predetermined destiny: extremely evil people and extremely good people. Extremely evil people, after death, fall directly into hell to receive retribution. And people who are extremely good, are fond of touching the heavens, accumulate positive virtues, save suffering and rescue, and receive boundless and boundless blessings, can break through their predetermined destiny and move upward, and after death, they will be born in heaven to enjoy happiness.

As ​​for the issue of prolonging life span, it can be achieved, but increasing life expectancy has limitations, it needs to be based on reason and dharma. Calling it like reason like dharma means that you are not healthy, you need to supplement food to nourish your body, absolutely do not kill and eat meat, this is something that is absolutely forbidden by the sound law. Not only can you not increase your lifespan, but you will also incur a debt of life due to negative consequences. People who seek longevity need to remember one thing: they must be vegetarian. If they harm their lives, how can they have longevity? The victim's life is bound to be filled with anger and resentment, just waiting for an opportunity, determined to take revenge, so fasting is the basis of longevity. Furthermore, it is necessary to develop great compassion to save all living beings from suffering and be happy, develop great bodhichitta to help all living beings, and maintain a vegetarian diet and liberate living beings throughout our lives. If you can really do so, then the positive life in the book of birth and death will definitely increase, but how much the number increases will depend on how big or small your dedication and merit is.

In the book of life and death in our hands, there are some people who did not pray but received more life. Some people are ordinary beings, they do not have a great heart to save sentient beings. It's simply that they genuinely have the heart to help others at a single thought, encountering grievances or moments of danger, their hearts feel compassion to save the suffering lives of sentient beings. This type of person will be periodically repaid by the god of life and will successfully have their life extended, but they also do not know that their life span will be increased, this type of life extension is usually from 6 to 12 years. If there are sentient beings who always accumulate negative virtue very deeply, they will not be able to use it all in one lifetime, so they often leave it to the next life to enjoy the long-life retribution. Life span in the human world is determined, the law of rewards and punishments cannot defy the laws of nature.

So A Ngoc would like to ask the judge: "Buddha in the scriptures taught the masses to eat less, sleep less, or even not sleep to practice. Does that affect their health and longevity?"

The judge said: "Buddha is a practitioner with great wisdom in the universe. The path that we practice is what Buddha has experienced step by step. Buddha is an experienced person, naturally knows how to teach the masses to walk on the path. Buddha taught the masses to practice like that absolutely does not affect the health of life, only those who violate the three karmas of body, speech, and mind, or do not know how to value the body, let themselves be greedy. Greedy eating, chaotic day and night life, mood swings, etc. are the causes that affect life expectancy.

Eating less and sleeping less is a very good way for the body to be in harmony, we humans can really do without eating or sleeping. If a human being can make every breath and thought correspond to the great nature, reach the unity of heaven and man, be naturally healthy and have a long life, can not eat or sleep, then return to the state of light and clarity as before reincarnation, but normal people cannot do that. Therefore, Buddha taught the masses to gradually eat less first, eat less, then naturally sleep less, then do not sleep but diligently practice.

Earlier, it was said that how much a person should eat before reincarnation has already been determined. Now, if you eat less, that is accumulating the blessings you deserve in this life. If you continue to eat less, sleep less, or even not sleep at all, practice diligently. Of course, day after month, you will accumulate great blessings and great good results. How can it affect your life span? Alright! A Ngoc, do you understand?” I nodded to show I understood.

The judge said: "It's okay to stop coming here today. If there's any problem, welcome next time!"

“Yes! Amitābha Buddha! Thank you judge!”

A Ngoc bowed to the judge and chancellor! Fly back riding a white lotus!

2. FINALLY MEET THE LONG LONG LEGENDARY HYPER - THERE ARE NO GOOD PEOPLE IN FRONT OF THE CHRISTMAS!

Thank you for your blessings from Buddha! Sit on the white lotus and depart!

Amitābha Buddha! A Ngoc clasped his hands and bowed towards the judge!

“Today I want to ask the judge: What is the legendary Khat Kinh Dai like? When I was young, I often heard the elders in my family talking, after death, people have to go to the underworld to look at Nghiet Kinh Dai. I don't know if it's true? I really want to go and see.”

The materials that make up Nghiet Kinh Dai are taken from divine wood and precious crystal, gathering the yin and yang aura of heaven and earth to form. The yin and yang aura of heaven and earth is yang, representing bright good karma. If a positive person practices good karma all his life, then his spiritual nature will be clear, and when he comes before the Khat Kinh Dai, a bright patch will appear, without any images shining through, so good people do not need to reflect on the Khat Kinh Dai. Yin represents dark shadows, i.e. evil karma. Yang people only need to do any evil karma while living, no matter how secret, in their own mind it will be very clear, everything will be collected in the Alai Da consciousness, captured in the mirror at the bottom of the heart, a negative image will be engraved in the heart.

Nghet Kinh Dai was originally formed by the convergence of two yin and yang energies. Once it encountered the negative karma of the sinful soul, the spirit energy immediately continued to communicate with each other, immediately revealing the evil karma of the sinful soul's entire life. The sinful soul would be exposed in its true form, no longer able to hide it at all and no longer be able to cover it up. True to the "Hoa Nghiem Sutra" that said: "If anyone wants to understand clearly, the three generations must necessarily be Buddha, and if he contemplates the dharma realm, he must create only the mind", that is the mind that appears.

As long as the guilty soul stands before Nghiet Kinh Dai, all the big and small crime secrets of a lifetime will all appear and shine. When Nghiet Kinh Dai showed the movie, all the living beings standing around Nghiet Kinh Dai clearly saw every bit of the evil deeds of the sinful souls. Many sinful souls feel ashamed and regretful.

If there is a person who practices good deeds and accumulates virtue all his life, is bright and righteous, has no concealment in his heart, and is filled with pure positive energy of good will, when he goes to Nghiet Kinh Dai, only a white patch will appear. People who do good deeds all their lives do not need to go to Nghiet Kinh Dai. When they receive their final life, they will directly ascend based on the level of purity of their spiritual nature. The purer their spiritual nature will be, the higher they will ascend. Some people will ascend to the Buddha lands that are predestined to them, and some people will be led by good spirits with merit and virtue to be reborn in the heavenly world. If the spirit is neither good nor evil, it will be subjected to the examination of the ten halls and then reincarnated into the human world. Depending on the depth of blessings, it will be reincarnated as a man, a woman, rich, poor, and short-lived, etc. . . As for the evil people, they will be brought before Nghiet Kinh Dai, their life's evil karma clearly visible before their eyes, then embarrassed and helpless and dragged away by ghosts."

“A Ngoc, follow me to visit Minh Phu Kinh Nghiep palace.”

“Obey! Judge.”

Now I see there are many people in front of me. There was a large, oval mirror. The judge said this was Nghiet Kinh Dai. On the top of the mirror is written "There are no good people in front of Nghiet Kinh Dai", the judge let me measure it.

Nghiep Kinh Dai is about 3.3 meters high; 1.8 meters wide, you can see a light blue rectangular wooden base with embossed patterns engraved supporting Nghiet Kinh. The front of the Mirror is precious crystal, the sides of the precious crystal are covered with light blue embossed patterns, and the precious crystal is the screen that will show the criminal soul's lifetime of criminal acts. The light blue embossed pattern emitted a flickering gloom, along with the ferocious face of the ghost next to it, making people feel very terrible! In addition, Nghiet Kinh Dai shows all the most secret evil karma that no one knows, the evidence is clear, watching it makes my heart want to burst, increasing the crisis!

The souls here have all just passed away, they all feel the atmosphere of hell, so most of them have sad faces. I just heard a male ghost say that I didn't kill or rob when I was alive, so why did you drag me here? Let me out quickly! Seeing two ferocious ghosts dragging a man and pushing him to Nghiet Kinh Dai, the man was extremely miserable and was forced to kneel. The large mirror immediately showed the image of a man committing adultery, not just one woman, that's right

can see more. This is called super adultery, leaving his wife lying on a hospital bed barely alive and dying. Luckily, these pictures don't affect me. If I don't see them, I'll have to go wash my eyes! At this time, the guilty soul's legs were shaking, and the devil was dragging him away.

See a female sinner again. This female sinner looks polite and has a dignified appearance. I wonder what crime she committed? The harsh mirror showed an image of her and her friends defaming a male layperson who strictly maintained the precepts and propagated the Dharma. This female sinner herself has studied Buddhism and her knowledge of Buddhism is very extensive. Unfortunately, out of jealousy, she intentionally defamed a male lay follower who strictly maintained the precepts and propagated the Dharma, and defamed this male lay follower who had once raped someone. Because of the successful slander, no one listens to the Dharma, so lay men can only practice in seclusion.

The degree to which this female sinner defamed this male layperson was greater than her friend. Because her friend doesn't have much knowledge of the Dharma, she's the type of person who lacks wisdom. Whatever people say, she says the same thing, just follows them and slanders her. And this evil soul carefully planned and put all its energy into using all kinds of ways to defame lay men, eventually leading lay men to practice in seclusion.

The sinful female soul also suffered from throat cancer due to blasphemy. At the same time, she developed other diseases, her mouth and nose oozed pus for a long time, and she was in the hospital suffering from sea water and suffering to death. At this time, the female sinner knew that great tribulation had come and immediately knelt down and asked for forgiveness. The ferocious ghost used a pitchfork to stab her in the mouth and said: "Let's see if you dare to slander the Dharma and destroy someone's life in the future? Now go see the King of Hell!"

The female soul is so pitiful! Knowing this early on, at first do not do anything that sabotages the propagation of the Dharma, which is the path to liberation of sentient beings. This is a serious evil karma that must be repaid in hell. The law of the underworld has all kinds of punishments to punish those who defame, but by the time the retribution of hell is over, how many more years will this world have gone through!

Next, behind the long line, all the sinful souls are lining up, there are so many sinful souls that you can't see them all, they all have to go to the Nghiet Kinh Dai, it can be seen that there are too many people in the world who create bad karma! Today, because of time constraints, I couldn't see much of the case. In fact, watching Nghiet Kinh Dai was a bit difficult, because it was filled with people who broke the precepts. Except for a few children, the rest are many horrifying bloody incidents, bloody scenes of murder, harming others, fighting over and losing, etc. . . Oh!!! It's impossible to interview every soul at a time, and I don't want to be thorough

too much description. If described in detail, this book "The Law of Heartless Sound" will definitely become a super horror book.

The judge said: "It's enough to come here for today, Ah Ngoc, go back and write a book, advising people in the world to try to cultivate themselves and nurture their nature, try to create good karma, don't think that people who don't know that heaven is not good create bad karma and then fall into hell. You need to know that before Nghiet Kinh Dai, no matter how big or small the evil karma is, it will appear clearly, I hope people in the world don't take advantage of the unknowing Yin Law!"

“Amitābha Buddha! Thank you judge!”

A Ngoc Huong judge joined the chancellor to perform the ceremony! Sit on the white lotus and return!

3. SUPREME COMMANDER OF THE DIEM DINH MINH QUAN DINH DIVISION

Image of Phong Do the Great, A Ngoc will now clearly report the truth as seen:

The Supreme Commander of the Underworld Emperor Minh Quan Minh Quan, also the Phong Do Great Emperor, has a handsome and strong physique, tall body, majestic and majestic, looking at it makes people feel extremely serious. The great emperor's face is round, his facial features are dignified, his eyes are large and angry, and his eyebrows and eyes exude extreme majesty. The Great Emperor will smile towards people who do good deeds. When the Great Emperor smiles, his appearance looks peaceful, but towards evil spirits, he is unusually serious and angry, his eyebrows and eyes keep rolling up, making people who see him feel scared.

When the Great Emperor shouted at the sinful soul, the sound shook the ears, the eyes were not small, but when angry, they opened wider, the mouth opened very loudly, it would hit the table, completely subduing the sinful soul! The Great Emperor makes people feel like strangers should not come so close.

On the Great Emperor's hat there is a rectangular front and back curtain. The rectangle is black, the curtain piece is white. The hat looks very majestic, it is a picture of the world, mountains and rivers, a type of ancient mandarin's hat, all in five colors. In the middle of the hat there is a red gem, on both sides of the red gem are blue ripples, above the ripple is a dark yellow land, on the surface of the land are green forests and high mountains, all combined together are extremely powerful, with the entire mountains and rivers in the human world concentrated on the hat.

The Great Emperor wears a royal robe with the six paths of reincarnation and 7 new colors. The six paths of samsara are circular, divided into five equal parts. At the top is the heavenly path and the asura path, there are celestial men and women flying, and there are asuras fighting with the heavenly army. Opposite the path of heaven and humanity is the path of hell, in hell there is a cauldron of oil to cook sinful souls, demons order to beat sinful souls, sinners hug bronze pillars, etc. . . Next to heaven clockwise is humanity, humanity is divided into 3 categories: rich people, workers and poor farmers. Below the humanitarian path in a clockwise direction is the orbital path; Demons have large-bellied, hungry hungry ghosts, very thin and small ghosts, smoke and fire ghosts, etc. . . Opposite the devil path are animals, poultry, wild animals, etc. . .

noi_dung:
4 . “MESSAGE OF THE SPIRITUAL SPIRIT OF MINH PHU” - THE Buffalo Head With The Face Of The Horse Explains The Entire Process When Duong People Die Together

Recently, it feels like the climate in many cities in the world changes every day in an instant, especially in coastal areas. One moment it's full of sunlight, the sun is so bright it makes people sweat, another moment the wind blows and pouring rain. If you go out on the street, if you wear a small umbrella, it will be blown back, making your whole body drenched. This type of weather usually happens several times a day. If you live in a coastal area, the weather changes will be even greater. If your body's resistance is a little weaker, you will easily catch a cold. Many people around you complain about the bad weather, the hot climate, and the poor surrounding air.

Going into the offices of large and small companies, the air conditioners in there are really cold, sometimes it's hot, sometimes it's cold, sometimes it's hot, sometimes it's cold, making people very tired, everyone wishes the climate could be a little better and more stable, even though everyone holds out hope, but in reality it's always like that, everyone hopes the situation will get better but everyone forgets that in their daily activities, they have treated the great nature. stars.

The discarded items we use every day such as chopsticks, tissues, packaging, have polluted the environment to a great extent. Every day we spend some commonly used items, home electronics, household appliances, genuine leather chairs, leather jackets, real silk clothes, beautiful products, do you think that behind the formation of these products, how many pitiful lives were sacrificed, or how much human and material resources were wasted to create them? Would these lost lives be willing to volunteer to provide delicious meals or let people peel their skin and wear them? If you interview those animals, they will definitely not agree, this is one of the causes of serious damage to the environment.

Second is the human concept, every day we take public transportation, or on the way we can see many people, their external expressions are very tired, unhappy, sad, anxious, afraid. In fact, they all have spiritual bodies attached to them, and it is very difficult to live happily and willingly. People's negative ideas keep blending into the surrounding space, the animals that are killed also keep spreading resentment and anger, they are always waiting for a chance to take revenge, always ready to create more accidents for humans. Our ideas actually directly influence change

natural climate change, the climate change we are currently experiencing is all the result of spreading our ideas. The scriptures say: "If you contemplate the nature of the Dharma realm, you must create only the mind."

Namo Amitābha Buddha! Thank you for Buddha's power! Sit on the white lotus and depart!

In front of me I saw a buffalo head and a horse face, I wonder where they went? Come and ask around! “Amitābha Buddha! Where are you two with the head of a buffalo and the face of a horse preparing to go?

Big Brother Niu Dau said: “Oh, A Ngoc is here, has the Am Luat accidentally finished writing?”

“A Ngoc is embarrassed! We must try harder to complete it quickly. Thank you both for your concern! Every time I see you two, I feel extremely busy. I would like to ask if your daily work is too stressful? If I accidentally arrest the wrong person, will I be dismissed by the King of Hell? At that time, the earth had clear mountains and clear water, the air was fresh, unlike now where everywhere is polluted, the chemical industry is polluted, and the thing that pollutes people's hearts the most is the wrong news from the news media.

At that time there were a number of fruit varieties on the ground, seemingly very fresh, fruit blooming everywhere. This fruit is very similar to the one in heaven. Heavenly people were attracted to this fruit. At that time, there were no humans on earth. Because the heavenly people keep the five precepts, they will not violate the precept of stealing, but because the fruit does not belong to any human species, it belongs to the earth, so the heavenly people begin to enjoy the fruit. After they ate, it felt extremely delicious, everyone continued to eat a lot.

Fruits belong to the earth. Heavenly people eat earth's matter and will have an inexplicable fate with the earth, so their feet have to stick to the ground to walk, making it impossible to fly. Even though the heavenly people have lost their magical powers to freely fly back to heaven, their magical powers still remain, they just lost the ability to fly.

The heavenly people were all able to go to heaven by keeping the five precepts and ten good precepts. The heavenly people who came to earth at that time still single-mindedly kept the precepts, believed in cause and effect, were kind and sincere, everyone lived together in harmony, peace and joy, and did not violate the precepts to create evil at all. But this scene did not last long. As the next generation of heavenly beings lived on earth for a long time, the light of spiritual nature gradually decreased, and the earth was polluted to the point where it lost its original beauty of clear mountains and pure air. Even so, the earth at that time was still much better than it is now. With the proliferation of humans, the light of the innate spiritual nature was lost, humanity's blessings decreased, people began to not keep the precepts and gradually became selfish, small accidents and small illnesses began to come one after another, hell also began to manifest according to the evil karma.

Hell in ancient times was very small, and very few people fell into hell, even if they were sentenced to punishment, it was only for a few years. There are people who are sentenced to punishment and then reborn in the human world a few years later, they reform themselves. After that, more and more people fell into hell, until today hell is overloaded. Currently, the penalty for falling into hell is usually over a hundred years, but it is no longer sentenced to a few years. This is caused by people's unrighteous thinking and behavior, seriously lacking the perspective of cause and effect."

Heavenly people of Quang Am Heaven are inherently a halo of light, with magical powers of flight, free transformation, not as heavy as the body of flesh and blood of positive people. This is due to a process of diligent practice in preserving the purity of the precepts, bringing blessings to the heavens. Just because of the impulse to try the fruit, the light of life's spiritual nature descends, and the power gradually disappears depending on the growth of delusions and attachments.

The next life of the celestial beings at that time will be the primitive humanity, because they will remember all the love and resentments etc. in the past, leading to disruption of normal life in the human world. And when she drinks the soup, Mrs. Manh will let her karma flow, all the things and people of her previous life will be forgotten, and she will continue to sharpen her mind.

Mrs. Manh's soup includes five flavors like in the human world, sweet, sour, bitter, salty, and also represents destiny after reincarnation in the human world, both bitter, sweet, and bitter. Mrs. Manh's soup looks the same, but the weight of each cup is different, and the main ingredients are the same. For example, there are some beings whose fate is quite good, with great blessings, noble birthplace, enough wealth, respected by others, healthy body, etc. . . When this type of person drinks Mrs. Manh's soup, it has a particularly sweet taste. If the blessing is less, it will feel especially bitter and sour. If the blessing is normal, the feeling of all five flavors intersecting, and when drinking, there will be a feeling of quenching thirst. Because karma is different, each living being who drinks Mrs. Manh's soup feels different. The goddess Manh also came from the human world, but did not fall into hell, but was sent by the Heavenly Emperor to take office.

Mother Manh is a person who studied Buddhism and practiced in the human world, maintaining her virginity and cultivating purity all her life. In the secular world, her name was Manh Ba. Her nature was kind and kind, and she enthusiastically helped the suffering people around her. Manh Ba saw the suffering of living beings in the human world, because of love, conflicts between family members, etc. . . At that time, there were also many women who had to live very miserable lives. In ancient times, women without talent had to be virtuous. A woman's position was limited to passing on the lineage, giving birth to children, and helping her husband raise children. And because of that, many women always live in tears and accept the pain. Mrs. Manh sees these situations clearly and tries her best to help some women who are predestined to her to reduce their suffering. This is what stimulated Mrs. Manh's development.

vows to help all sentient beings forget their suffering, to enable everyone to forget the past and continue to live a new life, many sentient beings were encouraged by Mrs. Manh at that time. She went everywhere advising people to observe precepts, fasting and chanting Buddha's name.

I also received a clear dispatch from the underworld here, I must take A Ngoc on a tour of the underworld. Together we will reveal Heaven's secrets to you, and wait until you return to the earthly world to write down what you have seen and heard in the underworld, and encourage people in the world to practice good deeds and accumulate virtue."

Ah! So that's it! There is still a road ahead, we can quickly penetrate it.

I saw three big words "Forgotten Dai" and "Forgotten Dai" is a very large place! It feels like a super cool water shop in the human world. There are three types of containers here that are not the same color. The Judge said that the transparent container contains soup that has a sweet taste, meaning the greatest blessing, the white container contains soup that gives sentient beings good blessings

normally, the black bin is reserved for the type of living beings with the lowest blessings. Even when the three types of ghosts were assigned to divide the costumes, Ms. Manh's outfits were also divided into transparent, white and black sets for the three types of boxes.

Many ghosts are busy pouring Mrs. Manh's soup into the cup. The cup is round, underneath there is a leg supporting the stem. If you look closely, you can see that the colors are the same, the size is the same, the shape is also the same. If you look closely, they are the same but there is a little difference. All the cups seem to be transparent, all unified, but there is a difference in the raised pattern at the base of the cup. The transparent cup has a smooth, bright base with no pattern. When the soul picks it up to drink Mrs. Manh's soup, the hand feels comfortable. Other types of glasses have a raised pattern at the base of the cup. When you hold it in your hand, you feel the pattern exists. The last type is the type with a raised triangle pattern. When the soul picks up and drinks Mrs. Manh's soup, it will feel like being stabbed, very uncomfortable.

In Forgotten Monument, there are many small rooms, divided into left and right sides. The left side is reserved for people with great blessings, where Mrs. Manh's soup has a very sweet taste. First check out the small rooms on the left, which contain a table and chairs. There was a cup of Mrs. Manh's sweet soup on the table, and two maids offered it to the soul to drink. That is, if you have great blessings, you can sit in the drinking room, which is a bit like a luxurious living room in the human world, and you can enjoy special treatment. Look at each room on the right, which also has a table and chairs. On the table there is a cup of Mrs. Manh's soup containing all five flavors, but only one maid offers it to the soul to drink, which means normal blessings can also sit in the room and drink.

“A Ngoc joins hands to greet God and Mrs. Manh!”

The God of Ba Manh smiled at me. The Judge said that the God of Ba Manh is mostly always at Ba Manh Temple. At Ba Manh Temple, many things often happen. Here, there are often situations where many souls refuse to drink soup. The sentient beings who come to Ba Manh Temple to drink soup are usually the type with poor blessings and relatively heavy karma, so of course there are many ghosts here, most of them holding very sharp iron bars in their hands.

I saw a lot of souls lining up to go to Ba Manh Communal House, they seemed to be very tired, they looked very thirsty. Some people have almost no strength left

moreover, the souls who can walk should go on their own, and in their turn they will hold the cup and drink. As for those who don't have the strength, the devil will help them come to Ba Manh Temple and feed them to their souls.

At this moment, I suddenly heard a scream, it turned out that the female soul refused to drink, she was beaten by two ghosts. Whoa! The female soul is so pathetic! A ghost used an iron trowel to hit her leg, she immediately fell to the ground and blood flowed from her leg. Another ghost saw this and stabbed her with an iron bar, pulled her up and forced her to drink three glasses of soup. Afterwards, they had to endure more physical suffering. After drinking Mrs. Manh's soup, the souls would kiss and sleep and be reincarnated by the devil.

When we were all children, we always raised our hands and opened our mouths when we were young. Therefore, we need to thank our parents for their upbringing. Moreover, we need to cherish alms giving, maintaining precepts, doing good deeds, and slowly accumulating blessings over many lifetimes. If you are a person who does not have enough blessings, like Africa, Estopia, Gango, some remote and backward places in China and poor countries, etc. . . There was a severe lack of food, many adults and children were starving to death, or were so hungry that their faces turned yellow, and they were also seriously malnourished, and had to wait for others to help. Sometimes, before waiting for others to help, they starve to death!

When each person is born in the human world, how much they eat, how much they wear, how tall and short they are, how fat and thin they are, whether they are noble or in need, accidents, property, when they will live together, etc. . . When he reaches the Maple and Autumn Grain Hell, he continues to eat all the food he wasted while alive until the end. A Ngoc followed me, now I'll take you sightseeing."

I've smelled the sour smell, the rotten smell of food, the smell of vomit, the sound of vomiting, the sound of coughing, and I've seen the big words "Flower Cereal Hell". This hell is so huge! I saw the Autumn Grain Hell full of young people. The Judge said they were not only condemned to this prison but also committed adultery and other crimes.

Now go over there and interview the young female soul! A large portion of this female soul's food area looks terrifying, I don't know how long it will take to eat it all. The female soul looks delicate and has delicate features, she is in pain and vomiting!

“Amitābha Buddha! How are you feeling? Can you tell me why you came here?”

“Can you tell me why you came here?”

“I said! I said! When I was alive, I really liked buying a lot of food, especially buying all kinds of delicious food, but I didn't eat much, afraid that obesity would affect my appearance, but every day I bought the food I liked. I have the habit of never eating old food, only eating fresh food. As long as there is a new product, I buy it immediately, if I don't eat it all, I throw it away. The female soul cried loudly! It's true that when you see this pile of sour, rotten, and stale food all over the worm's proboscis, there's no point in eating it anymore.

Looking at the seemingly older female ghost next to her, her private food area is several times larger than the previous female ghost, it's so scary! At this time, the devil sent her to the other side to continue eating.

A Ngoc would like to ask the Judge: "So if the food is accidentally spoiled, do we still have to eat it all?" Amitābha Buddha! Thank you Phan Quan! A Ngoc bowed to the Phan Quan with his palm!

noi_dung:
8. THE BLESSINGS THAT PEOPLE ACCUMULATE WITH HARDNESS, BUT THROUGH SMOKING, THEY LOSE IT!

Thank you for your blessings from Buddha! Sit on the white lotus and depart!

Amitābha Buddha! A Ngoc bowed his palms to the Judge!

Today I want to ask the Judge: "Regarding the issue of smoking. In many cities there are advertisements for cigarettes. In some rather advanced cities, the advertisements will clearly state that cigarettes contain nicotine, smoking is harmful to health, or in some public places where smoking is strictly prohibited. On the contrary, in some backward cities, restaurants, bars, and tables have ashtrays everywhere. Someone smokes. According to the law, can smoking constitute a punishable sin?"

Phan Quan said: "Smoking has too many harmful things, hundreds of harms but not a single benefit. Roughly speaking, in addition to directly affecting health, reducing blessings, shortening life, dissipating money, people don't like it, having a strange smell in the mouth, gloomy body light, often causing illness, not having enough right qi, it also directly causes environmental pollution that harms the health of others. If you are a person who studies Buddhism, then the dharma protector will leave, there is no way to leave. born in the Pure Land.

According to the yin law, smoking will lead to some punishments. Yang people who smoke will lose their own blessings. This loss of blessings is divided into two types: the first is damage to the functions of the internal organs of this flesh and blood body. For example, important organs of the body, lungs, liver, brain, eyes, nose, trachea, large and small arteries, etc. . . will quickly degenerate, causing all kinds of chronic diseases of the internal organs. This disease is caused by smoking, just quit smoking and the disease will improve. As for the loss of blessings and shortened lifespan due to smoking in the past, you can compensate by repenting and accumulating merit, advising people to quit smoking, etc. Second is the loss of innate spiritual light. The degree of impact of this loss will be greater. Ultimately, humans need to always enhance their own innate light. If the innate light is lost, everyone's life will definitely go towards darkness, it's all suffering, no one wants to suffer, all sentient beings want to be happy.Smokers themselves will not be healthy, smokers always have a shorter life span than non-smokers, young men and women who smoke will lead to infertility, especially young women who smoke will lead to menstrual physiological disorders. When the menstrual cycle comes, it will produce all kinds of stomach pain, back pain, shoulder pain, headaches, anxiety, the body is hot and cold or feverish, etc. . . Many people think that this is normal, but in fact it is caused by smoking. If you can quit smoking, your physiology will return to normal. Of course, there are some cases that have nothing to do with smoking, where a woman's physiological cycle is also related to her karma.

before them, there would be some women who had special physiological periods. They never smoked, but their physiological periods were extremely painful and had severe menstrual pain. No matter how much medicine they took, it was ineffective. They could only wait for each month's menstrual period to pass naturally, that is, to use the pain to eliminate karma. Another case is having to deal with menstruation month after month, having to live in misery and all kinds of inconveniences that menstruation causes, the blood slowly flowing out, forever unable to move well, seeing a doctor is useless. These two types of women are both due to the residual karma of killing and sexual karma in previous lives, leading to menstruation in this life. These two types of women must develop a mind to repent of the karma of past lives, must adjust their psychology to eliminate karma first, one is to eat vegetarian, recite Buddha's name, practice good deeds and accumulate virtue, and must use some suitable foods to nourish them, then over time they will gradually get better.The type of woman with this disease must definitely develop the mind to eliminate past evil karma, the power to repent of past evil karma every day, plus the great blessing of reciting Buddha's name, the power of good deeds and the power of accumulating virtue. These three types of power include the power of repentance, the power of Buddha, and the power of merit combined. If you follow the above instructions and practice every day, using these three types of power will slowly eliminate karma and return to normal.

When people encounter all kinds of unsatisfactory situations in life, they should ask themselves why everyone else is normal and only themselves encounter such things. This is due to your current karma, you must first repent of your own karma, you must correct your daily actions, all things must be done according to reason and dharma. Even if the ability is not enough, as long as you do your best, in terms of cause and effect, it can be considered perfect without defects, the rules of cause and effect of the law of sound are always just and strict.

If a pregnant woman smokes, it will reduce the baby's natural immunity, affect the baby's brain development, and also affect various functions of the internal organs. Pregnant women who smoke give birth to children who often have poor immunity and are easy to give birth

All lives in the mother's womb during pregnancy is the period of innate creation of that life, that is, the period of building the physical body of that person's next life. Before each person enters the womb, the blessings of the next life have already been determined. Although the karma has been determined, the habits of good and evil behavior can be changed later in life, meaning they can continue to go higher or lower.

The mother's 10-month pregnancy period is very important. If the mother smokes during pregnancy, then the fetus is inherently defective, and the extent of the defect depends on how much the mother smokes. If a pregnant woman has a good idea of ​​prenatal behavior, it will create a good foundation for the child's life in the next decades. Those who have the opportunity to read this literature are blessed sentient beings. I hope everyone will spread the word to each other. If a pregnant woman maintains a pure holy life during the 10 months of pregnancy, even stops having sex, does not smoke or drink alcohol, is a pure vegetarian and recites Buddha's name, her soul always maintains a state of peace, then it is extremely beneficial for the development of the brain, the adjustment of internal organ development and the fetus's later personality. Although vegetarian food in this world has chemicals, it is better than the harmful effects of meat food and avoids negative relationships with sentient beings. As for the benefits of vegetarianism, we will not say more here. In this world, there are many books related to vegetarianism that you can refer to.

A smoker, in addition to losing his blessings and longevity, if he smokes for a long time causes the person next to him to exhale the smoke from his cigarette, the smoker will lose even more blessings. Because that person directly harms the health of others, he is doing an act that harms others without benefiting himself.

there must be all kinds of obstacles, so it can be inferred that smoking more than two packs will make the obstacles worse. If there is someone next to the person who smokes, there will be more harm, such as poor human relations, sudden scolding, etc. . . People who smoke for a long time, in addition to losing their blessings, also have their lives shortened.

If a smoker in the designated network gets a raise this year, this blessing will be eliminated. As for doing business, he was able to make some money as expected, but at the most important moment, something went wrong and he couldn't complete the transaction, etc. . . People who smoke for a long time will gradually dim the light of their innate spiritual nature. At the end of their lives, they will not be able to be reborn in a good path, they will only fall into hell, because all the light of their body has been obscured by cigarette smoke.

I said: "Phan Quan! My grandfather also smoked for many years, yet he lived to be 92 years old! This makes it difficult for me to persuade my father to quit smoking!"

Your grandfather was originally a long-lived person, 92 years old is the age that has been reduced. Before he died, his lung function degenerated. Due to coughing and starvation, he died and was breathless. He died earlier than expected, and it wasn't entirely due to smoking. Another factor was that when he was 90 years old, my aunt had no one around to take care of him. Your aunt mistreats him, normally doesn't give him anything to eat, and often curses at him. At first, your aunt strongly requested to take care of your grandfather, her goal was to take over all of your grandfather's assets. She didn't understand cause and effect and thought she had succeeded. On the contrary, your grandfather wanted to protect the peace in the family, choosing to endure everything himself, not telling anyone until he was alone. Another cause of his death was starvation. Thanks to this, he not only eliminated karma but also accumulated some blessings, so later when A Ngoc son started studying Buddhism, he recited Buddha's name a little and was transcended to heaven.It's because your grandfather was willing to accept everything before he died that he received such good rewards, and your aunt planted a huge evil karma. Being so unfilial, 6 years later her only handsome son will leave her, her retribution has not yet ended, then her daughter will take all her assets and leave, just as unfilial to her, your aunt will also suffer and die. It can be said: good and evil have their consequences in the end, who has fair karma ever spared? The official advises the world's people, don't cloud your conscience and do bad things, everything people do is recorded by the underworld. If you do many unjust things, you will be punished by heaven. If you sincerely do good deeds, God will bless you. Everyone should remember the words of this official.

I said: "The Judge's words really surprised me, I felt very bitter in my heart. My grandfather had a degenerative lung disease before, he coughed and lost his breath and died. As for my grandfather's assets, I heard a little from my parents, saying that my aunt took all of them and left them, and my parents felt embarrassed about this. As for starving, I remember, no wonder every time I visit my grandfather, I buy food for him. Grandpa ate everything. At that time, my aunt said that from the time I was young, I was the only one who knew how to buy food, saying that the food I bought from my grandfather loved to eat, and was not ashamed to have been raised by my grandfather. At that time, when I heard it, I was very happy. I still remember that every time I came to visit my grandfather, I always followed him, thinking that the next time I came to visit, I would buy more food that he liked, because I worked outside and only returned home every half year. times, the next time he felt so sad!!!

Phan Guan said: "Karma is like that! Everything is beyond cause and effect! The law of sound never misses an extremely complex cause and effect interwoven in each hairline, each cause has an effect. Your grandfather's smoking has the karma of smoking. His prolonged smoking caused the lungs of his relatives to be affected, your grandmother coughed because her lungs were degenerated, phlegm was stuck in the throat and could not come out, hindering breathing and inhalation. If you don't die in the next breath, your grandfather has to bear part of the cause and effect in this matter, and your grandfather's practice of patience also has some merit.

Anyone should not smoke, smoking will destroy their normal thinking, if they are Buddhist disciples they must quit smoking. Smoking belongs to the fifth precept of not drinking alcohol in the five precepts. In ancient times, Buddha established the five precepts for lay people, based on the main scriptures in the present, although it does not directly say not to smoke, only instructs not to drink alcohol. Alcohol further paralyzes our nervous system, sabotages normal human thinking, sabotages spiritual practice, causes living beings to create evil, and eventually fall into hell. Unless it is used to treat diseases and save lives, it is necessary to prepare medicine and there is no other alternative, then do not touch a drop of alcohol. Don't fool yourself and then fool others, thinking that drinking alcohol without getting drunk is not a crime.

Therefore, the true purpose of keeping the fifth precept of not drinking alcohol is: all foods that paralyze and destroy our normal thinking must be forbidden. Not only alcohol, current social science is constantly changing. In the future, new products such as alcohol and medicine will appear in the human world. As long as it is a food that has a paralyzing nature that destroys normal thinking, the entire world must abandon it. This point I hope everyone

Okay! It's okay for A Ngoc to talk about smoking today, you can go home now! Welcome again next time!”

Sit on the white lotus and fly home!

Phan Guan said: "In the 350th year after the Song Dynasty, there was no way for the world to resolve it, and many large and small unjust cases that had no conclusion began to continuously increase. After this type of unjust soul descended to the underworld, all of them wanted to report to Dong Nhac Dai De. Dong Nhac Dai De's great judgment hall became a gathering place for many unjust souls. Last time A Ngoc visited the court hall of the Supreme Minh Palace, that was when it was newly built. Phong Do the Great also moved to the Palace of King of Hell to work. already.

After his death, he was appointed to be the first king of Hell. The content of Dong Nhac Dai De's work is no different from that of King Minh Quan, the only thing is that after some ghosts enter hell, they must denounce it to the supreme King of Hell. judged by King Minh Quan himself. In fact, this is the habit of people in the earthly world, everyone who comes to Minh Palace, every King of Hell in Minh Palace is fair and strict. All Hell Kings follow the rules of the law, based on cause and effect to handle cases, there is absolutely no favoritism towards relatives and friends, everyone looks at what hell the soul has committed and decides which hell to go to, if there is any injustice, they will issue that kind of death warrant."

Going across this circular bridge, the mandarin palace behind is the palace of Dong Nhac the Great. The mandarin's palace was very crowded. On the bridge there were many Yaksha marching back and forth. When they met the Judge, they all bowed. With the Judge leading the way, you don't need to look everywhere for directions, it's much simpler and quicker. We actually walked through hell very quickly, unlike the human world, where we slowly walk away with one step and one footprint on the ground. Sometimes when the Judge walks fast, I also have to speed up. We use our mind power to walk without our feet touching the ground. Hell is really so big, I have never been on this road before, but I also don't want to remember the way in hell. I wish that the sentient beings of hell will soon learn and understand the Dharma and practice, and that soon they will all be able to escape the suffering of hell. We have now seen the palace of the Great Emperor Dong Nhac. In front of the door, there is Da Xa standing neatly in front of two large red wings. After Da Xa bowed to the Judge, he opened the door for us to enter.

After entering, two other ghosts smiled to welcome the Judge, and led us through the corridor of a garden and then to the main hall of the trial. This trial hall is clearly smaller than the supreme trial hall of King Minh Quan, here it feels more ancient, the house is old-style with large red iron doors, the furniture and decorations are all ancient colors and incense, on the walls there are pictures of ancient people, on both sides of the walls are ancient weapons, opposite the main door there is a sign with the four words Dong Le Great Emperor, there is a King of Hell sitting there who seems to be Emperor Dong Le. Emperor Dong Nhac wears the King of Hell's costume, his face is brown, his head wears a crown, and his eyes emit black light. Ah! Upon closer inspection, it turns out that he is a King of Hell with an extremely serious and somewhat ferocious appearance. On his desk are written the four words Dong Nhac Dai De.

“The people of Thuong Quan Ngoc Hoa, meet the Emperor Dong Le!”

A Ngoc: "Yes, Great King of Hell! The people want to ask King of Hell a few questions:

First, the women heard that hell is saturated. If positive people continue to commit adultery, hell is already full. Even if you commit adultery, there is no new hell that can be arranged. Even when it is time to die, you will be temporarily exempted from the punishment of hell, waiting for hell

Is there a place to receive punishment in prison? Or must we release fewer hell beings in the present, making room for new guilty souls to suffer?

Second, those who have committed many crimes of adultery, according to the sound law, must have their blessings reduced and their lifespan reduced. Is there any way for sentient beings who commit adultery to completely avoid the punishment of hell when they die?

Third, is there any way to completely avoid committing adultery?”

Dong Nhac Dai De said: "Oh! A huge aura of adultery from the earthly world has directly rushed into the great hall of the Heavenly Emperor. Adultery has seriously hindered the balance of the righteous energy of great nature. If the human world continues to lose the balance of righteous energy of great nature, all kinds of natural disasters will arise. For example: the weather is unstable, in a moment there will be all kinds of changes, sometimes it rains, sometimes it's sunny, sometimes it's hot, sometimes it's hot. The temperature of the day can change very quickly, in one day you can experience four seasons: spring, summer, autumn, and winter, tsunamis, water disasters, fire disasters, earthquakes, and major infectious diseases in the human world are all warnings.

A Ngoc! Try to think about why there are so many tragic things happening on Earth in Nam Thiem Bo Chau? Surely there is a cause of common karma due to some post-natal human actions. That's why I hope that "The Law of Sound without Emotion" can quickly awaken the ignorant hearts of people in the world, have the effect of saving people's hearts, changing the atmosphere of society, and making the vast majority of sentient beings peacefully observe the five moral principles. Changing the energy of sexual immorality has brought all kinds of disasters to the human world, and has also allowed this overwhelming hell to be at ease, and the human world will not have to constantly have major disasters in a short period of time. If the situation of sexual immorality in the human world continues to be rampant as before, then in a short period of time there will be a large-scale, earth-shattering disaster that will follow. All sentient beings who commit adultery or other crimes will not be able to escape the heavenly net of the law of the law of evil, they will all be cleared by the net of the law of the evil law of the evil law, in the great disaster, falling and suffering limitless and limitless hell punishments.

Even though this underworld is already full, the underworld will arrange to find another place to build more hell. Even if this hell is completely destroyed, if the beings in hell still have not finished their karma, we will transfer these sinful souls to another hell to continue receiving punishment, until all their karma is completely eliminated before they can leave. If sentient beings in hell want to leave hell, there are only two reasons: one is that their sins in hell have been paid off, and they will be reborn in the corresponding fate according to the aftereffects of hell. Minh Phu also has a Dharma Assembly Hall opened by compassionate Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva. If in the great hells there is a sinful soul with a sincere intention to repent, Yaksha will lead him to listen to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's compassionate teachings. From there, thanks to Buddha's blessing, he will develop good roots and be promoted to the good realm. The most terrifying are those who never repent for their past mistakes, are stubbornly ignorant of falling and suffering, and even constantly increase their karma.

One ​​thought of sincere repentance is enough to eliminate immeasurable and boundless sins. The law of the merciless Sound Law absolutely never binds sentient beings who are truly sincere in their repentance. Most of the souls coming out of hell are first born as small animals with simple thinking in the animal world. Even if one is born in the human world, one's blessings will be poor, the five senses will not be enough, etc. . . Second, there are sentient beings who are fortunate enough to have the supernatural power of their relatives on earth and can also leave hell. In the records of Minh Phu, there are cases where relatives from the earthly world were transported to a good realm, and some people were even promoted to heaven or the pure land of bliss. But this is not a coincidence, it is all because these sinful souls, before falling into hell in their past lives, had accumulated some blessings, rather than suddenly being saved, there must have been good causes and conditions that led to them.Therefore, all sentient beings should take advantage of the time when their five senses are full and their body is healthy to try to do many good deeds, obey the law, keep the precepts, accumulate merit, try to accumulate blessings for themselves, absolutely do not use this healthy body to commit acts that violate the precepts and fall into hell, once falling into hell, you will suffer immeasurable and boundless suffering, with no day of release.

Those living beings who have committed adultery or created evil karma in hell, if there is a cause, there is an effect, creating evil karma in hell, in the future they will definitely suffer the retribution of hell. If you do not want to receive this retribution, then when the retribution has not yet taken shape, you must cut off all the supporting conditions that create the retribution. If you want to completely avoid committing adultery in this life and fall into hell, there is only one way, which is to completely abstain from all adultery. First, you must always seriously manage your thoughts, do not let the slightest thought of adultery arise in your heart, not even a single thought, even if you have a subtle sexual immorality, you must immediately repent, immediately develop a thorough mind, and in the future you will not have such adultery thoughts again, and at the same time, constantly change it. Advising people not to commit adultery, developing such a mind is very important.

Those sentient beings who have a relationship with this book, should sincerely make a sincere intention to completely eliminate sexual misconduct but have failed many times, can make a vow to the heavens on the first or fifteenth day of each month, from now on for all eternity to not commit adultery, and assist in printing or passing on the good book "The Law of the Heartless", and generally strictly observe the absolute abstinence of conduct related to adultery. Observe a vegetarian diet, especially do not eat foods that increase sexual desire, as well as cooked onions and garlic will increase sexual desire. Herbs with aphrodisiac properties must be used as little as possible, such as Ba Can (a type of mushroom).

Amitābha Buddha! A Ngoc paid homage to the Judge!

Today I would like to ask the Judge: regarding the Earth Gods that people often bow to at the Earth Temple, are they angels or Earth Gods? Is there a difference between the Earth Gong in each house and the Earth Gong in front of the door?

They can enjoy the incense and fire of worshipers, as authorized by their superiors. This type of deity is differentiated according to large and small merits. The Earth Gong manages these large areas. Yang people often build a temple to worship them. The Earth Cong's job is to maintain security in the area where sentient beings reside. If any evil spirits or demons enter the area under the Earth Cong's jurisdiction, the Earth Cong will handle it properly and perform well in the role of protecting positive people. All Earth Gongs are people who like to help people while they are alive, and are very righteous. They are sent to serve as Earth Gongs to receive the fruits of humanity in the world. Only Earth Gongs with great merit can receive offerings and worship from the public.

The Earth Cong in every house or in front of the door is of the type of Phuc Duc Chanh Demon with little merit. These Earth Gongs in the house or in front of the door are actually placed by Yang people with an offering tablet and are called Earth Gongs in the house or in front of the door. In fact, they are ghosts. As long as they stay in that house, their lifespan is longer than that of humans. If humans do not enter the house, demons will not be worshiped. If a positive person makes an offering, the ghost will also repay the favor, naturally protecting the person entering and leaving safely. Currently, positive people often buy and sell houses, ghosts will not follow, they will only change the owner of the house, but Earth God sent by heaven will not. Earth Gods in large areas sent by heaven are often shopping malls or high-rise buildings, as well as high-rise apartment buildings where Yang people live today. These Earth Gongs are in front of these trading floors, because the center and shops have many people coming in and out, so some Earth Gongs with great merit are needed to enjoy the incense fire. Okay, A Ngoc coming here today is enough, you go home first."

There are many that rely on the positive body, and there are some that rub their hands and fists as if they want to fight.

At this moment I saw a man with a bit of white light on his body, he seemed to have some righteous energy. When he entered a slightly dark alley with no lights, the devil also gave way to him, waiting until he passed before the devil turned back. So it seems, there is a little difference.

Tho Dia Cong's grandfather said: "Recently in this place there was an unmarried man, he committed adultery and fraud. She had the intention of killing, wanting to die with this man, but this man's blessings were not over yet, his life was not lost. He was a monk in his previous life. In recent days, he seems to feel that something is wrong. For example, a few days ago, when he went to withdraw money, the machine did not come out, but it did not go smoothly. Even though all the working procedures were correct, inexplicable problems kept arising, my help could make him withdraw. from awakening.

This is just one sentient being, every day there are many different types of sentient beings, there is also a lot of work, naturally it will be very busy. Just now, when you saw a demonic being, you will also give way to them. In fact, I will also help this type of being. If he is about to fall, I will lend a hand or help him in every way to avoid falling, but the positive person will not feel my existence, the positive person will only feel that he is not falling, just a little closer to falling, how lucky! Actually, this little bit is just a blessing for them."

I said: “It's been too hard for Grandpa Tho Cong! It turns out that he secretly helps everyone so much, A Ngoc only found out today. It's so grateful! Goodbye, Grandpa Tho Dia Cong!”

Thank you for your blessings from Buddha! Ride a white lotus!

“Amitābha Buddha! Ah Ngoc bows to the Judge with his palm! Please ask the Judge if positive people commit false speech, what will be the retribution in hell? Phan Guan said: "It's a bit long-winded when it comes to false language. Today, this official will roughly explain it a bit. False language really has a huge impact, one lie is enough to harm one person's life or even many lives. False language is the companion of greed, hatred and delusion. People who commit false language will attract hellish retribution.

When lying, you must consider the moment when the positive thoughts of a positive person arise. When lying, at that time the mind tends towards greed, hatred, and delusion which of these three poisons is more. Sometimes there is only one of the three, for example there is only greed with no other ingredients. Sometimes there is only hatred, sometimes there is only ignorance, sometimes there are two or three components.

All false language can be divided into two types: real false language and false false language. True false speech will attract various levels of hell retribution. Of course, we must consider the level of harm to the victim caused by false speech to decide whether the hell retribution is heavy or light. Those who speak falsely do not have to suffer the retribution of hell. There are types of false speech that can create merit.

Why is it called false speech? As well as for the sake of saving sentient beings, there is absolutely no selfishness or personal gain, lying purely for the sake of saving sentient beings, which is called lying. There is also a very similar type of false speech that Yang people often use, for example: someone asks A Ngoc if you have eaten yet. A Ngoc, because he does not want to bother others cooking or is afraid of owing others, says he has eaten, this is called false speech. This type of false language contains a thought of self-benefit. All false language that only contains the thought of self-benefit is false speech. If you have ever spoken through the means of false speech, before receiving the final sentence, you must develop a sincere and pure heart of repentance. You must repent, because the means of false speech is the premise of true false speech. The means of false speech, if used regularly, will pollute our innate spirituality, and will gradually nurture the habit of true false speech.

this language is misleading. If you have forgotten that, then try to be sincere in changing your previous mistake and never make it again. Remember carefully, although the sound law is merciless in punishing wickedness, the above grace always has mercy on sentient beings who truly repent, definitely leaving a step for these sentient beings to step up to the realm of light, restore the innate light of sentient beings before falling to the human world, and pray for the blessings of Buddha's power to eliminate karma. From now on, recite Buddha's name to seek rebirth in a pure land. If there is no Buddha statue in the house, you can report to the void. You just need to sincerely repent. There are Buddhas and Bodhisattvas everywhere. On both sides of each person, there are two Black and White Impermanences recording all the good and evil deeds of the masses in daily life.

The cause is not right, the result is skewed, speaking false language by means will also attract the retribution of false speech, therefore, false language must be repented and purified. Otherwise, if we do not truly borrow the power of sincere repentance and the Buddha's power of reciting the Buddha's name to thoroughly purify it, then we will definitely suffer retribution. If you use any kind of mind to speak false language, you will receive retribution corresponding to the intention when lying. There are many hells related to false speech, I will take you to visit the newest false speech hell. Ah Ngoc, follow me!” Annoy the Judge! Let's follow the Judge and set off, we will quickly fly to a hellish area.

The Judge introduced and said: "This is the northern part of our underworld, this entire area is a kind of false hell."

Wow! Another extremely large area! I can't see it all with my ability to see, and this place needs to be built more, it's unbelievable!

Phan Quan said: “Today, A Ngoc, I'm going to visit one of the hells of false speech first! Later, arrange time to visit other places.”

Thank you Judge! The temperature here is very low, it's so cold! It's a bit difficult to adapt to, the temperature difference between the North and South in the winter is very large in the winter, but it's still adaptable, but the temperature in this hell is really too low, too cold! We must immediately chant Buddha's name to adjust our mental strength to adapt to the extremely cold environment of this hell!

Phan Guan said: "The temperature here is minus 150 degrees, this is the hell area for false speech that began to be built in the year 2000 in the earthly world. Right now we are in the area of the heaviest punishment for false speech, the Cold Ice Bac Dam Drunken Body Hell, here is the coldest and most miserable place. To the south of the underworld, where the old Ten Halls are, there is an old false speech hell, of course Even the punishment they have to endure is suffering of level 1. Oh! Nowadays, the world is depraved, people's hearts are heartless, there are many people here who talk falsely, leading some positive people to give up a pure life to cultivate themselves and nourish their nature, believing in lies and searching everywhere

earn, immerse yourself in the life of the five desires, indulge in life and death, destroy people's lives, and experience the fate of falling into the Cold Bing Ba Thi Drunken Body Hell. Today, Ah Ngoc, please visit the Cold Bing Bat Thirteen Drunken Body Hell!"

No need for me to introduce, everyone knows that the characteristics of hell are the endless screaming, suffering, and terrible screams. But the feeling of suffering here, time and space seem to be slowed down by the cold, everything feels very slow.

This hell is super big, I see many people in there suffering and receiving punishment, a part of the guilty souls on the left side have almost the same retribution. In hell, there are many computer-shaped devices. The computers are all automated sets, which often shoot out devices to chase down evil souls. The target is 100% accurate, never missing any evil souls. There are also organs on the wall and ceiling, some figures will fly out, this is a modernized hell. Yaksha, in addition to angrily treating the escaped souls, is also busy operating computers to punish the souls. The souls here are truly suffering, in addition to always having to face extremely cruel Yakshas, ​​but also having to endure involuntary computer torture. This hell has many evil souls and computer-shaped devices, but there are few Da Xoa. First, look at the two evil souls next to the wall! A man and a woman receive the same retribution.

The female sinner was so cold that she began to tremble. She was very miserable. Her movements were extremely slow as she climbed up from the ground, or perhaps restored her human form. At this moment, the evil Yaksha immediately stabbed the female soul in the back with a long spear. The female sinful soul cried out in pain and was then skewered by the Yaksha and brought to a computer. The computer screen in a split second released two snakes, one black and one red. The two vicious snakes rushed to the sinner's mouth, the red snake bit the mouth, the black snake bit the tip of the tongue, pulled the tongue off and threw it on the ground, and then accurately flew into the bloody mouth. The slimy flesh of sinful souls.

After the sharp spike shapes are stabbed into the sinner's body, the female soul is almost so miserable that she faints. After she faints, there are many insects that eat up her body. The female sinner's blood splashed, puddles of blood flowed on the ground and were then sucked up by the worms. Because of the force of karma, the sinful soul then awakens, thus continuing the cycle of experiencing sins.

After hitting him a few times, his mouth was crushed and bleeding. After beating him, he was dragged to another desktop computer.
