When these objects touch the sinful soul's mouth, the sound of "swoosh, swoosh, swoosh" immediately melts the sinful soul's mouth. Oh! It's terrible, it's so painful! It's so sad!

Yaksha retracted his cruel face, then said to me: "The female sinner A Ngoc saw earlier, when she was still alive, because of jealousy, she spoke false language to slander a monk who kept the pure precepts, intentionally sabotaging the monk's propagation of the Dharma. Also because of her false speech, it led to many people believing in it, many people therefore lost their faith in studying Buddhism and practicing good deeds. Keeping the precepts. Because of this crime of false speech, when she was sentenced to fall in this hell, King Minh Quan was furious and sent her to this hell for a lifetime. When she finished her term in this hell, she had to go to another hell to continue receiving retribution.

And that male sinner worked as an advertising therapist during his life. Because of lying, he earned a lot of money in a short period of time. Many positive people believed his advertising lies and suffered damage to all kinds of internal functions of the body. People with mild cases will have chronic and strict internal functions for life. People with severe cases will have their body functions decline in a short time, and even die. But most people do not know that due to his false treatment advertising, the male sinner's soul had his blessings reduced by the government, and his life was reduced in a car accident.

This hell is all about committing false speech when living, when living with false language that slanders those who propagate the Dharma, when living with evil intentions and lying words that lead to harming the lives and property of others, or when using false language to incite others to do things that violate the precepts, when living with false language and selling goods that are harmful to the body and mind of positive people, when living with false language and defrauding the property and chastity of others, etc. . . Equality of evil karma. There are too many cases of lying here, it is impossible for each person to mention them all, what was said earlier is the most recent sins that will lead to this hell."

Phan Quan continued: "In general, all intentional false speech in life, as long as it harms the body, mind, life, and health of positive people, must fall into hell and receive corresponding punishment. If you have the opportunity to read this literature, I hope to be able to develop a sincere intention to change your mistakes, and try to advise the public to recite Buddha's name (to rely on Buddha's blessing to eliminate the negative karma created in the past), when Also keep the thoughts of body and mind pure, advise the public not to lie, our innate light will be a little dimmer. If the innate light of positive people is gloomy, it is easy for undesirable things to appear, causing all kinds of illnesses, and even all kinds of disasters to come one after another.

Okay, A Ngoc is here for a temporary visit today! I have to go to a meeting for a while, tomorrow the opportunity will come again!”

Thank you for your blessings from Buddha! Sit on the white lotus and depart!

“Amitābha Buddha! A Ngoc heads to the Judge!”

“I would like to ask the Judge, if a positive person speaks using excessive words, uses all kinds of language that harms the self-esteem of others, angrily insults people. Adults scold children, husbands and wives quarrel, speak to oppress others, use cruel language and curse, do these acts have to fall into hell and receive punishment?”

Phan Quan replied: "If a person often speaks evil words, his mind is often angry, oppresses others, uses cruel language to hurt people, insults people, all are counted as evil speech. For example, cursing people for being animals, or cursing those who die, cursing those who are absolutely dead, scolding the dead for having no place to bury themselves, even cursing at some things that person takes very seriously. For example, person A really wants to have a son, but now Because the wife's body cannot reproduce, and there are only five daughters, the person who commits evil speech will deliberately use abusive language and have no one to live in to attack Mr Speech leads to others not being able to live, being ashamed of life, and even committing suicide. Any harsh language that harms the body and spirit of positive people is considered evil speech, especially all kinds of extremely cruel language.

If you commit evil speech, you will fall into hell and receive punishment. Evil speech is a type of cyclic evil habit. Evil speech and greed, anger, and stupidity are partners, so those who commit evil speech all have anger in common. It's just that the malice of each person who commits evil speech and karma will have different depths and shallows. If an evil mouth is committed against a practicing saint, it is enough to make a living person fall into hell and experience boundless and boundless suffering of all kinds; Even if hell ends, it will circulate the path of animal birth through all kinds of sufferings of animal birth, and when reborn, it will also be a lowly human, until the residue of evil speech is completely eliminated. During the long period of receiving the karma of evil speech, due to being too miserable, it is very easy to produce a number of new karmic forces, leading to endless suffering. Unless you meet a good knowledgeable guide, develop the mind to correct all your wrong actions, practice good deeds and accumulate virtue, only then will you have good causes and conditions to escape from the sea of ​​suffering, otherwise it is truly a boundless sea of ​​suffering, eternal damnation!

Those who fall into hell receive punishment. During their lives, most of them are spouses, friends, colleagues, parents, siblings, and everyone who commits evil speech towards each other. Husband and wife are the most and are also the most likely to commit evil speech. Women account for a higher percentage. Here, the official serves to advise women to carefully guard their speech karma. Many women, because of their own heavy black karma, are guided by past black karma, and their lives always encounter all kinds of hardships in body and mind; There are people who, during periods of physiological instability, often commit all kinds of evil speech and hurt those around them.

The disease of humans is that they are used to acting from the perspective of their own interests. As long as there is something unfavorable, it is easy to resent the people and things around them. Heaven and earth and the circumstances of everything do not coordinate. They never make mistakes, so they let negative emotions arise in the moment and commit all kinds of evil words that hurt others.

If you want to prevent evil speech, you must first maintain a peaceful and stable state of mind; To maintain a peaceful and stable state of mind, you first need to examine your own mistakes, always consider whether you have done something wrong or if you have used the wrong language. The present world's society is in a period of dishonesty and disorder. It is indeed very difficult to maintain a peaceful and stable state of mind. There are many external temptations of all kinds of obstacles, but even if it is difficult, we still have to break through the obstacles; If you cannot overcome it and commit all kinds of evil speech, you will end up in hell, and you will only have to suffer, not others. When the compassionate Buddha was still alive, he foresaw all kinds of obstacles for sentient beings in the Dharma Ending Period to escape from the sea of ​​suffering. It would be very difficult for the masses to maintain mindfulness and cultivate the Way. Therefore, he specially passed down a method of reciting the Buddha's name, helping the masses to easily be saved.Just simply recite Buddha's name, constantly recite Buddha's name and fast every day, rely on the Buddha's power to silently resolve and slowly purify our body and mind, keep our daily thoughts calm, transform our daily negative thoughts into good thoughts of Buddha's name, thereby cultivating good thoughts of Buddha's name into a good habit, and use this good habit to replace all kinds of bad habits in the past, so that our destiny will gradually change, gradually. Then the future will gradually move towards light, and then the light of our innate spirituality will be restored.

The light of the body of the person who commits the lowest evil speech is red. The serious person will turn from red to dark red. If they do not repent and constantly commit evil speech, they will turn from dark red to black. Black is already very serious, and will attract all kinds of undesirable events to arise. People with red light bodies have problems in human relations, are often depressed, and easily get angry. As for beings with a dark red body light, it is easy to attract sentient beings of the demonic path to approach. Demonic path beings often have heavy anger and are very easily angry. As long as a Yang person gets angry, there will immediately be angry ghosts flying to their aid, plus a number of bondholders from the spiritual world next to them (beside each person there are a number of unjust people following, it's just a matter of more or less), they will add fuel

fire affects positive people. As long as a person is angry, the demon next to him will call that person to be even hotter. The more excessive the words, the more cruel and bitter they become. This will cause the positive person to not be able to control the fire of his ignorance and rise 3,000 feet high, so the karma of evil speech cannot be recovered at once."

Phan Guan said: "Yes! A Ngoc's situation partly belongs to this situation, the other part is due to the fact that your family member is a being born in the demon path. In this life, she only has one goal: to hinder you from practicing, not to let you do the job of maintaining the Dharma smoothly, you must definitely repay virtue, practice diligently, and maintain the purity of the precepts to gradually change her; When her behavior is too dramatic, I can find a way to avoid it. Because of her fierce behavior, it is also an invisible part that creates A Ngoc's unusually resilient personality. I must thank her for constantly cultivating my steadfast mind in practice, seeing that in difficult circumstances I can maintain a steadfast bodhi mind to liberate life and death."

“I understand, thank you for the enlightenment of the Judge! A Ngoc will definitely remember the solution method that the Judge taught, to return virtue to evil, diligently practice and keep the precepts, gradually inspire your family members, and will definitely practice properly.”

“Continue your efforts, Ah Ngoc! Right now, this official will take you to visit the evil mouth hell. Next to the "Han Bing Ba Thiet Drunken Body Hell" there are a few echo hells, the temperature is a bit higher, not as cold, but still as painful; today I will take you to the second part of the echo hell, the temperature is not cold anymore."

We flew quickly. When we were about to descend, the Judge pointed and said, it's right in front of us. I bowed my head to see, oh! There were two snakes with terribly big heads lying there. The snake's head was so big it was scary, but they couldn't move. They had never seen a snake with such a big head. A red super big-headed snake and a black super big-headed snake, their mouths opened very wide. It turns out that the red snake's huge, terrifying mouth is the big door of this hell. Next to the big door are many scary little snakes, actually not small, just because the two snakes just now were too big, I felt like these were a lot smaller, red, black, and blue, this hell was built in the shape of a snake.

On the big door is written the words "Single Snake Nails of Hell". Oh! After being poisoned, he was crucified. The Yaksha bowed to the Judge, opened the door and led us in. Before we even went inside, we heard an extremely terrible sound, the sound of "Shissy, Ahah, Xexet", like the sound of biting something off, cries of sorrow, feeling that the terrible sounds emanating from here were both numerous and chaotic, all the mixture was deafening, it was very unpleasant for the ears to listen to. We started going into the snake's huge mouth, and a Yaksha reminded me not to get too close inside, but to just stand on the side and take a look, saying that there were many organs inside. This hell has a lot of computers, the cruel Yakshas are all very busy, quickly operating many computers to punish them for their sins. It seems like there is clearly a shortage of staff here, the Yaksha's operations are very quick and expert. Without the help of computers, Da Xoa would definitely be even busier. Here it is indeed as the Judge said earlier, the evil hell has more female sinners.Coming to this hell, I feel the pressure on my head and psychology is especially great, I have a headache and an unspeakable discomfort in my heart, so continue to visit! Seeing the suffering of sinful souls, these discomforts are insignificant at all.

There are many evil souls here. All of them were bitten on their tongues and mouths by the poisonous red snake flying out of the computer. Each computer makes a terrible sound, very difficult to hear. When the sinful soul is bitten in the mouth and tongue by a poisonous snake, its entire body is poisoned, turning black and purple, and falls down in pain; Some people scream loudly, some people don't make a sound and fall to the ground in a coma. At this time, poisonous snakes will shoot into the sinner's ears and emit all kinds of terrible sounds to wake them up. When the sinful soul woke up, sharp red-hot hooks immediately flew out from the ground and hooked them into their ears. The sinful soul's ears instantly melted along with the hissing sound. At the same time, the poisonous snake continues to pull out the tongue and intestines of the guilty soul and throw it to the ground. Then the computer will emit hot steam to boil the tongue and intestines of the guilty soul, until the tongue and intestines become very small, but there will also be a computer that releases hard ice to smash the tongue and intestines of the guilty soul and splash.

After the sinful soul's tongue and intestines are boiled in boiling water or smashed by hard ice, the computer will release a few double-headed sharp spikes, pinning them all over the sinful soul's tongue and intestines. At this time, the poisonous snake bites the sinful soul's tongue and intestines, all of them fly and stuff into their mouths, letting them cry out in pain, rolling on the ground and screaming; Sinful souls just continue to commit sins like that, never getting any rest.

At this time, a female sinner suddenly knelt towards me and kowtowed. Of course, Da Xoa did not forgive her, and was viciously kicked by Da Xoa to the side of the computer. Oh! What a hell

inhuman carpet! What a pitiful female soul! At this time, the Judge ordered Da Xa to bring that female soul to me for an interview to write a book, and Da Xa immediately brought it here.

At that time, I said blankly: "Sorry! We must have met before. You are my grandmother's friend, right? It's been a long time since an elder called me that. May I ask why you came to this place?"

After my grandmother passed away, this little guy was completely taken with me. I didn't expect to be called back in hell today by someone else; The image from before appeared, suddenly time turned back, in that moment sadness filled the soul.

The female sinner said: "Tieu Ngoc Tu! It's normal that you don't remember me. I rarely interact with your grandmother. Our houses are not far away, but my house is located in a place where every house has to pass. When I was young, I often liked to dance when walking; every time I passed by, I only needed to hear the sound of her footsteps; when I passed by my house, I often worked in the living room, and often saw a ghost. At that moment, my two daughters often asked: Why do Tieu Ngoc Tu have fun every day, but we don't stop doing housework every day? Then I scolded them harshly: "Who said you were born lowly, born into poor families, and are all short-lived ghosts?" You guys didn't try and were born as girls; If you were boys, I would let you go out every day and not go to work. There's nothing admirable about that, Tieu Ngoc Tu's family just has a bit of money, what's the use of a big house, no one lives there. Even though he plays every day, there's nothing interesting, he's also a short-lived ghost, he can't become a boy."

“Her grandmother was famous for being an honest person in that place, and liked to help others. As long as it was something she had, everyone lent it to everyone, even if she didn't return it. But after her daughters-in-law got married, she had to hide things and lend them to everyone, otherwise she would be scolded by her daughter-in-law. She had enough of the insults from her daughters-in-law. At that time, I often thought that it was because her grandmother was too gentle that she was constantly bullied by her daughters-in-law, thus So I was determined to be fierce and not let anyone bully me. My aunt often said that after she was born, she was much happier. She often said that she was very resilient and had a manly personality towards everyone. I just looked at one side of her and suddenly felt like she was Tieu Ngoc Tu. Do you remember 20 years ago in your hometown, there was a case of a daughter-in-law biting off her mother-in-law's finger?"

A Ngoc: "Ah! I remember, so you're that person! This is so famous, I've heard of it, but I don't know who it is. At that time, I was young and didn't understand the business of adults. I heard my grandmother say that the mother-in-law and daughter-in-law were at odds. It seemed like the mother-in-law wanted to hold her grandson, and she gave birth to two yellow flowers at once. I also heard that the two of them often quarreled. But her age is not high, so why does it happen so quickly? to hell?”

The heartbroken female soul cried loudly: "When I was alive, I had a very bad temper. I scolded people every day. I scolded everyone. If there was even the slightest bit of dissatisfaction, I would definitely be scolded loudly, using some harsh and cruel words. Even if the weather was not good, affecting the work I had to do, I would curse the weather, it was so stinking, it rained at the wrong time, it would be so annoying, mother-in-law and child." My daughter was also scolded by me every day. When she was still in my hometown, I just married her mother-in-law, who was still young, and my finger was bitten off. Then, because I lost the ability to reproduce, my temper became even more unpleasant. My mother-in-law was absolutely no match for me. Every day, I scolded her for being old and refused to die. After a few sentences, she walked out. Every time she lost to me, I definitely had to win against her. Sometimes I beat her until her head was broken and her finger was bitten off. It was just the first blow to her when she married into the house.

I had hepatitis and died at home. With a buffalo head and a horse's face, I was dragged to hell. The King of Hell was angry and said that I was cruel and scolded people when I was alive. I beat and cursed my mother-in-law. I was angry and cursed heaven and earth. I was very ungrateful, unjust, shameless, shameless, disrespectful, disrespectful. I thought when I was alive that I could overwhelm the people around me by being cruel and loud, but now it feels wrong, "Hu hu hu", it's so painful. Tieu Ngoc Tu! Why are you going to hell? Please, help me out!”

At this time, Da Xoa fiercely shouted: "Don't say any more, immediately return to the punishment, A Ngoc is busy visiting hell, has to write a book to save people, has no time to talk to you, and won't go away soon." Da Xoa's ironclad immediately attacked.

The female soul's body trembled in pain, crying and saying: "Tieu Ngoc Tu! Can you take me with you to write a book? Everyone in your hometown knows that you have been well educated by your grandmother since childhood, and have a personality that likes to help people. I believe that Tieu Ngoc Tu will save me. You will definitely not die without saving me. Even though we rarely interact, we still have a good relationship. considered a neighbor, please take me with you to write a book to advise everyone

don't speak evil words, I will definitely prove it to you, explain clearly how I committed evil speech and had to fall into hell and suffer, I will help you advise everyone not to speak evil words, please help me escape!”

“Auntie! Amitābha Buddha! Seeing you fall into hell, I'm truly heartbroken. I also hope to be able to quickly save you from it, but I don't have enough ability to do that. Even if the injured person forgives her, her mother-in-law does not pursue responsibility, forgives her disloyalty, the justice of the negative law will not forgive her Because she was temporarily repentant, the mandarin also sympathized. I will instruct Da Xoa to record a record of her cooperation in repentance as well as a record of listening to the Dharma once in the underworld.Because when she was born, she was not filial, and now she can't be grateful to her future generations by practicing good deeds and accumulating virtue to dedicate to her. Her old relationship with A Ngoc as a distant relative in the past has now matured, leading to the opportunity to meet each other for a while today. Minh Phu always gives those who sincerely repent a chance to hear the dharma of liberation. But the first condition must be to see that the mind of repentance arises to a level of light. Your spiritual nature will be cleansed and blessed by Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva's compassionate sounds. For now, your repentance power is not bright enough. tom_tat: 15. A THOUSAND TIMES YOU CAN'T FISH - HELL THE POISONED SOUL FISHING FOR THE SEAFOOD Namo Amitābha Buddha! Paying homage to the Judge! A Ngoc: “Today I would like to ask the Judge, the sentient beings who like to fish
noi_dung:
15. A THOUSAND TIMES YOU CAN'T FISH - HELL THE POISONOUS SOUL FISHING FOR THE SEAFOOD

Namo Amitābha Buddha! Pay homage to the Judge!

A Ngoc: "Today I would like to ask the Judge, what kind of retribution will there be for sentient beings who like to fish? I see that there are many people in the world who like to fish and consider fishing to be a form of entertainment. Even though the fishermen know very well that the sea water in the city is dangerously polluted by heavy metals, they catch fish and let them play on the shore for a while. Some people, after scraping part of the fish's scales, even gouge out their eyes and cut off their fins. fish, internal organs, etc., and throw the fish into the sea. Would such actions lead to hell? If there is this hell, A Ngoc wants to visit a little bit."

Judge: "Fishing is an act of killing, whether for entertainment or fishing for food, it is a crime of killing, and will fall into hell to receive punishment. The distinction is: if the person fishes for entertainment, the fish's life and body are not damaged, and can swim to the ocean to live normally. The karma is relatively small, but it is also the type that damages the fish's consciousness, causing the fish to panic and fear, and make a bad relationship with the fish being caught.”

“If you only have the mind of entertainment and no intention of killing, each time you fish, you will eliminate one month's blessings, including the blessings of eating, drinking and all kinds of enjoyment for a month. For example, a fisherman will get a salary increase next month, but because of the current black karma of fishing, he won't get a raise, will be lectured by his superiors for no reason, will be looked down upon by colleagues, will not be liked by others, his body will be reflected by the karma of killing fish. Naturally, there will be pain that suddenly arises. If it's a business, if you sign a contract with a big customer next month, for example, you can earn one million, it will be reduced; if your previous life's blessings are big, you will have all kinds of hardships to earn three hundred thousand.

If, because of entertainment, the fish are caught and the fish's body is injured, they must eliminate a month of blessings and suffer all kinds of physical illness. The detailed report of the illness is: how the injured fish suffer, the karma will be reflected back onto the fisherman's body. Fishermen will suffer from all kinds of diseases such as headaches, dizziness, oral sinus disease, mental imbalance, etc. v. . . People with congenital cleft lips are all born from fishing karma in previous lives; Even the body has all kinds of pain, all similar to the feeling a fish must endure. As for fishing to eat, each time you eat at least 7 days of life and eliminate 3 months of blessings. If the number of fish caught is too large or the fish is caught to become pregnant, the law of the Mingfu will increase the punishment for the fisherman depending on the record of the fish being caught. People who often fish, their light body will change from red to brown; at

When each person is born, the body of light is circular, the color and color depends on each person, the body of light represents the good and evil karma of each person. Bright, perfect body light that shines far and wide represents people with great good karma, good virtue, great wisdom, Buddhas and bodhisattvas have the most perfect body light.

It was said before that for every newly born person, there are always two birth gods who follow him day and night; No matter where the Yang person goes, even going to the bathroom, bathing or going to bed, they follow, until the Yang person lives together. The two fisherman have the appearance of a man and a woman. The male fisherman is on the left side of the Yang person's pale white body, responsible for recording all kinds of good thoughts and good deeds every day of the Yang person; The female fisherman has a light black body. On the right side of the Yang person, she is responsible for recording all kinds of evil thoughts and evil actions every day of the Yang person.

When the Yang person creates too much bad karma, the female fish god will angrily notify and remind, only a few parts of the Yang person can absorb some weak signals, most people do not feel it, the two god fish will report the good and evil of the Yang person to the clear palace every month.

If it is a great evil person who is dangerous to the human world, if it is a person whose life has not yet expired, the Minh Palace will urgently make arrangements, causing disasters to come to that person, causing that soul to quickly return to the Earth Palace to receive punishment. A positive person, in addition to their own karma, all the actions of this life can produce new karma. The blessings of karma are due to the increase and decrease of good and evil actions in each day."

A Ngoc: “Thank you very much to the Judge for such a clear explanation. I would like to ask the Judge, just fishing for fun, you have to eliminate the blessings; So if you are a person without good fortune and often go fishing, wouldn't it be very bad?

Judge: "That's right! A fish is also a life.
